---
name: Change request
about: Create a report to improve Fork3X
title: "[CHANGE] Where's the change - What's the change"
labels: enhancement
assignees: VikkoMakesStuff

---

**Is your change request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is.

A change request must be made when something doesn't work as you would've expected. Feature requests (to add new features) must be created [here](https://github.com/VikkoMakesStuff/Fork3X/discussions/new?category=ideas).

**Describe the solution you'd like**
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen or want to change.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered. Workaround are very helpful because it helps visualising your expectations.

**Additional context**
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
